name: Multica v0.6 AI Agent Team Workspace
description: Assign issues to coding agents like teammates and track every run.

PORT.description: Port Caddy listens on; the public domain and the healthcheck target it.

MULTICA_WEB_UPSTREAM.description: Private address of the Multica web app (receives every path not listed below).

MULTICA_BACKEND_UPSTREAM.description: Private address of the Multica backend (receives /ws, /api/daemon/ws and /health).

PORT.description: Port the Next.js server listens on (the gateway and the healthcheck use it).

HOSTNAME.description: Bind address. '::' is dual-stack in Node, so IPv4 and IPv6 private networking both work.

REMOTE_API_URL.description: Backend origin (no path). The web server forwards /api, /auth, /v1 and /uploads there at runtime.

DOCS_URL.description: Where /docs is proxied to. Leave the official docs or clear it to disable /docs.

PORT.description: Port of the Go API/WebSocket server (dual-stack); the healthcheck probes it.

APP_ENV.description: Enables production safety checks (insecure JWT secrets and fixed verification codes are refused).

DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres connection string on the private network.

DATABASE_MAX_CONNS.description: Max Postgres connections per backend replica. Keep replicas x this well below Postgres max_connections (100).

MULTICA_DATABASE_STARTUP_TIMEOUT.description: How long migrations and the server keep retrying while Postgres is still starting.

REDIS_URL.description: Redis for per-IP auth rate limiting, the realtime relay between replicas and task-claim caches.

JWT_SECRET.description: Signs sessions, daemon tokens and attachment/avatar URL signatures (generated). Changing it logs everyone out.

ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: REQUIRED. Your email address (comma-separated for several). Only these addresses, allowed domains and invited people can sign up.

ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS.description: Optional. Comma-separated email domains (e.g. example.com) whose users may sign up.

ALLOW_SIGNUP.description: Keep false: new accounts only for ALLOWED_EMAILS, ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS or workspace invitations.

DISABLE_WORKSPACE_CREATION.description: Set true after creating your workspace so other users can only join workspaces they are invited to.

FRONTEND_ORIGIN.description: Public URL of the app (the Gateway domain). Change it when you add a custom domain.

CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Origins allowed for CORS and the realtime WebSocket origin check.

MULTICA_APP_URL.description: App URL used in invitation emails, CLI login and links.

MULTICA_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public API URL for webhook URLs and the daemon setup command shown in the UI (same origin via the Gateway).

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Optional. Resend API key to email login codes and invitations (HTTP API, works on every Railway plan). Without it codes are printed to this service's logs.

RESEND_FROM_EMAIL.description: Sender address on a domain verified in Resend. Required as soon as RESEND_API_KEY is set.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. Google OAuth client ID to show 'Continue with Google'.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional. Google OAuth client secret (with GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID).

GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI.description: OAuth callback to register in Google Cloud Console when Google login is enabled.

S3_BUCKET.description: Railway Bucket name for attachments, avatars and uploads.

AWS_ENDPOINT_URL.description: S3-compatible endpoint of the Railway Bucket.

S3_USE_PATH_STYLE.description: Railway Buckets use virtual-hosted-style addressing. Set true only if the bucket's Credentials tab says path-style.

ATTACHMENT_DOWNLOAD_MODE.description: Serve files through the backend so the bucket stays private and needs no CORS setup.

RATE_LIMIT_TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Private ranges (Gateway, web app, Railway edge) whose X-Forwarded-For is trusted for per-IP auth rate limits.

MULTICA_TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Same trusted ranges for the webhook rate limiter and the WebSocket origin check.

MULTICA_VCS_INTEGRATION_ENABLED.description: Enable self-hosted Git providers (Gitea, Forgejo, GitLab), as in upstream's self-host compose.

MULTICA_VCS_SECRET_KEY.description: Base64 32-byte key encrypting Git provider tokens at rest (generated). Keep it; losing it makes stored tokens unreadable.

MULTICA_PLUGIN_SECRET_KEY.description: Base64 32-byte key for plugin secret settings and hook signing (generated).

MULTICA_SLACK_SECRET_KEY.description: Base64 32-byte key encrypting bring-your-own Slack app tokens; enables the Slack integration (generated).

MULTICA_TELEGRAM_SECRET_KEY.description: Base64 32-byte key encrypting Telegram bot tokens; enables the Telegram integration (generated).

DO_NOT_TRACK.description: Upstream sends one anonymous deployment snapshot per day. Set 1 to turn it off.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time for open WebSocket and daemon connections to close cleanly on redeploy.

MULTICA_RUNTIME_TOKEN.description: Optional, set after first login: a personal access token (mul_...) from Settings > API Tokens. Until set, this runtime stays idle.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Lets Claude Code agents run on Railway (or log in with a subscription over Railway SSH).

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Lets Codex agents run on Railway (or run 'codex login' over Railway SSH).

MULTICA_SERVER_URL.description: Backend URL on the private network; the daemon's HTTP and WebSocket traffic never leaves Railway.

MULTICA_APP_URL.description: Public app URL used in links the daemon and agents produce (follows the backend's FRONTEND_ORIGIN).

MULTICA_DAEMON_DEVICE_NAME.description: Name of this machine in Settings > Runtimes.

MULTICA_DAEMON_MAX_CONCURRENT_TASKS.description: Agent runs executed in parallel on this service (upstream default 20 is sized for workstations).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Grace period for the daemon to deregister cleanly on redeploy.

PGDATA.description: Location where the database will be initialized.

PGUSER.description: Required variable for the Data panel.

PGDATABASE.description: Required variable for the Data panel.

PGPASSWORD.description: Required variable for the Data panel.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database created when the image is started.

DATABASE_URL.description: URL to connect to the Postgres database.

POSTGRES_USER.description: User to connect to the Postgres DB.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Password to connect to the DB (generated).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow Postgres to shut down cleanly.

REDISHOST.description: Private network hostname of the Redis service, only resolvable from services in the same environment.

REDIS_URL.description: Connection string for connecting to Redis using the private network.

REDISPASSWORD.description: Alias of REDIS_PASSWORD for clients that expect the unseparated name.

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Randomly generated password for authenticating with Redis.
